newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvian central bank cuts refinancing rate.
newsitem.headline: Latvian central bank cuts refinancing rate.

text.p: Latvia's central bank on Thursday said it has cut its key refinancing rate to six percent from seven percent.
The bank said in a statement that it reduced the rate, which is a key market indicator in the Baltic state, due to falls in interbank rates and on government Treasury bills.
The refinancing rate is the minimum rate at which banks can obtain two week funds from the central bank.
The rate was last cut on February 14.
